candidate: TATG-MAPPO with the Causal Event-Triggered Topology Memory (CETM) module
base_actor: the existing snapshot SG-MAPPO role graph actor produces h_i,t from its unchanged current graph interface

local_topology_state.legal_scope: receiver row i only; blue-blue relations and edge-age features only

memory_formula.initialization: x_i,0 = x_i,reset; m_i,0 = 0; previous action is the fixed neutral-action one-hot at reset
memory_formula.invariance: if delta_i,t = 0 then eta_i,t = 0 and m_i,t = m_i,t-1 exactly

training_invariants.ppo: unchanged objective, epochs, optimizer, reward and environment

mandatory_controls.generic_gnn_gru: same current topology vector x_i,t and previous own action, same GRUCell input dimension and hidden dimension, but uses m_i,t = GRUCell(concat(x_i,t, one_hot(a_i,t-1)), m_i,t-1) every step
mandatory_controls.capacity_rule: CETM and generic GNN+GRU use the same GRUCell dimensions and the same final Head input dimension; their added actor parameter counts must be exactly equal
mandatory_controls.ablation: CETM with delta forced to zero; this tests whether any effect is transition information rather than parameter count

serialization_contract.reset_rule: reset all three tensors at every environment reset
serialization_contract.checkpoint_rule: save and restore all three tensors with actor, optimizer and RNG state; exact continuation is required before any training authorization

forbidden: implementation or PPO training during P1.5
pass_authorizes_only: a separate implementation and exact-serialization audit; not PPO training
